name: Planning Commission Regular Meeting Notice of Continuation and Adjournment (PDF)
agenda_text:
ORDER OF ADJOURNMENT

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  Regular Meeting
  Monday, December 18, 2023
  7:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

The Alhambra Planning Commission met in the Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall
commencing at 7:00 p.m. on MONDAY, December 18, 2023. Commissioners present: OLSON,
BRYDEN, GARDEA, JUAREZ, TSUJII. Commissioners absent: GARCIA, GRIJALVA, HO,
MOJARRO, PHAM. City officials present: Erica Vega (Deputy City Attorney), Vanessa Reynoso
(Deputy Director of Community Development), Maia McCurley (Principal Planner), Megan Wu
(Associate Planner), Jessica Vargas (Planning Technician).

ADJOURNMENT - N2M23-152

As instructed by the President, after a roll call vote with a motion by Commissioner Gardea and
seconded by Commissioner Bryden, the meeting was adjourned at 7:10 pm due to a lack of a
quorum to 7:00 p.m., on Tuesday, January 16, 2024, in the City Hall Council Chambers, 111
South First Street, Alhambra, California. Any and all public hearings that were duly noticed to
be heard on Monday, December 18, 2023, at 7:00 p.m., were duly continued to Tuesday,
January 16, 2024, at 7:00 p.m. and no further notice was required to be given.

ANDREW HO
PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY

DATED/POSTED: December 19, 2023
Notice No. N2M23-152
